Thirty-minute pepperoni pie.d: Thin crisp crust, crushed tomato, low-moisture mozzarella and cupping pepperoni, baked on the hot deck.
Thirty-minute pepperoni pie.note: 29 minutes or it's free. Clock starts when you hang up.

Joe's Pizza garlic knots.d: Our pizza dough tied and baked golden, tossed in garlic butter and parsley.
Joe's Pizza garlic knots.note: Six free with any pie, with the coupon.

Potato knishes.d: Mashed potato and fried onion in thin pastry, baked golden. Yellow mustard.
Potato knishes.note: Hot from the case by the register.

Aunt May's pancakes.d: A tall stack, light and fluffy, cooked in butter. Maple syrup. Just like your aunt makes.
Aunt May's pancakes.note: Saturday and Sunday mornings. Just like your aunt makes.

Iced coffee.d: Cold brew over ice with milk and a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
Iced coffee.note: For drivers who are running late.
